channelTitle: The witch in a house on chicken legs - the real Baba Yaga story - Part 1
hook: Deep in the Russian forest there is a hut that walks on giant chicken legs - and the girl who knocked on its door was sent there to die.
storyParts: Vasilisa's stepmother hated her - so she sent the girl into the forest to fetch fire from Baba Yaga, the witch who eats children. Everyone knew no one came back.
But Vasilisa carried her mother's blessing - a tiny wooden doll that whispered advice in her pocket. The doll told her exactly which path to take and which roots to step over.
She found the hut: crooked, swaying on two enormous yellow chicken legs, fence made of bones with skull-lanterns glowing in the dark. Baba Yaga flew in riding a giant mortar, rowing with a pestle.
The witch sniffed the air and smiled a black-toothed smile - you smell of a blessing, girl. Serve me one week and earn your fire, or become tomorrow's soup.
Her first task was impossible - sort a heap of mixed grain in one night, or be eaten. While Vasilisa wept, the doll moved on its own and picked every grain clean before dawn.
cta: Will Baba Yaga let her go - or does the forest witch have one more test? Part 2 is in the Baba Yaga playlist.
moral: Kindness carried quietly - a mother's blessing, a little doll - outlasts the cruelest witch in the forest.
